sections.section_name: Section A - Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) / Fill in the Blanks

questions.question_text: What hand tool is most appropriate for loosening topsoil and removing small weeds in a school kitchen garden?
Fill in the blank: A __________ register helps document the local flora and fauna found within the school surroundings.
Which of the following is a simple machine consisting of a grooved wheel and a rope, commonly used to lift heavy objects?
Organic compost used to enrich the soil in a kitchen garden is primarily made from which of the following materials?
options: B) Dry leaves and vegetable peels
questions.answer: B) Dry leaves and vegetable peels

sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define the term 'Flora' when recording entries in a school biodiversity register. [15-25 words]
questions.answer: Flora refers to all the different plant life, including trees, shrubs, herbs, and grasses, naturally occurring in a specific local environment or school campus.

questions.question_text: State two practical benefits of maintaining a kitchen garden in your school. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A kitchen garden provides fresh, organic vegetables for school meals and teaches students practical skills about plant growth, soil health, and environmental responsibility.

questions.question_text: Explain how a lever helps make our physical work easier and name its three main structural parts. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A lever makes lifting heavy loads much easier by multiplying our applied force. Its three main structural parts are the fulcrum, the effort, and the load.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are setting up a rainwater collection system for your school kitchen garden. Describe how you would build and use a 'pulley' simple machine to draw water from a deep underground storage tank. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would install a sturdy fixed pulley system above the underground water tank. By threading a strong rope through the grooved wheel and attaching a bucket to one end, I can easily pull the opposite end downwards to lift the heavy bucket of water for irrigating the plants safely.
